description: Flutter 3.22 Windows builds can render a black window or fail with GL_INVALID_VALUE on older GPUs until the Windows engine fix in 3.24.1, based on https://github.com/flutter/flutter/issues/150546.
prompt: A few customers with older Windows 10/11 PCs say my Flutter desktop app opens to a black window after I updated from 3.19. The buttons still seem clickable, and one debug run on a customer PC printed `Fatal GL Error GL_INVALID_VALUE(1281) encountered on call to glTexImage2D`; what should I ship?
